Credits and sources

Strait Escape is a fictional satirical game. Its characters are caricatures. There is no affiliation with, approval by, or endorsement from Donald Trump, any government, or any military organization. All game dialogue is fictional except for the archival excerpts identified below.

The route was created for the game, loosely inspired by the geography of the Strait of Hormuz. It is not an accurate map, is not based on weapon sites or military operations, and is not intended for navigation.

The ship and caricature were created in Blender for this game, with no external models or textures. The environment, animations, drones, effects, sea, engine and drone sounds, and finale music were created for the game. No voice imitation or voice cloning was used.

Archival audio excerpts

“You're gambling with World War III. You're gambling with World War III.” — Donald Trump. Both original consecutive repetitions, one contiguous edited 5.46-second excerpt from the 28 February 2025 Oval Office meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, 43:54.640–44:00.100. Author: The White House. Source: Wikimedia Commons; official event page. Commons identifies the footage as public domain in the United States (PD-USGov-POTUS), with a recorded license review. This fictional satirical reuse does not imply endorsement. The audio is a contiguous original excerpt, not generated speech.

2026 State of the Union excerpts

Donald Trump, 24 February 2026 State of the Union address. Author: The White House. Official White House footage mirrored on Wikimedia Commons; official source identified by Commons. Commons identifies this government work as U.S. public domain (PD-USGov-POTUS). Contiguous original excerpts, with mono conversion and loudness normalization. No synthesized speech, fake repetition or rearranged words.

  • “Our country is winning again.” — 17:23.45–17:25.86, 2.41 seconds.
  • “You're going to win big; you're going to win bigger than ever.” — 17:49.45–17:53.00, 3.55 seconds.
  • Full “winning too much” joke — 17:31.50–17:53.00, 21.50 seconds. Includes the complete setup, plea and reply, ending “you're going to win bigger than ever.”

These archival excerpts are reused in a fictional satirical game. No affiliation with or endorsement by Donald Trump or the U.S. government is implied. U.S. public-domain status does not resolve other applicable rights.

Player-supplied audio excerpt

“Bomb the shit out of them.” — Donald Trump, a 2.53-second excerpt supplied by the player for use after missile dodges. The supplied audio is used unchanged, not generated or voice-cloned. Its original recording source and license have not been independently verified. Its use in this fictional satirical game does not imply affiliation or endorsement.

“We also took the Gulf of Mexico, and now it’s the Gulf of America.” — Donald Trump, a 7.03-second player-supplied recording excerpt used once at the start of each unmuted voyage. The selected audio is used unchanged. Its original source and license have not been independently verified. No generated or cloned voice is used.
